name: Critical Care ICU
description: Medical / surgical critical care: shock, sepsis and respiratory failure – daily SOFA, sepsis hour-1 bundle, lung-protective ventilation with a per-shift VAP bundle, daily rounds, devices, discharge.

definition.title: SOFA Score – Daily
definition.description: คะแนน SOFA รายวัน คำนวณจากค่าแลบ – one entry per day

sections.title: Daily SOFA · คะแนน SOFA

fields.label: Respiration
fields.formula: IF(pf < 100 AND resp_support, 4, IF(pf < 200 AND resp_support, 3, IF(pf < 300, 2, IF(pf < 400, 1, IF(pf >= 400, 0, NULL)))))

fields.label: Coagulation
fields.formula: IF(platelets < 20, 4, IF(platelets < 50, 3, IF(platelets < 100, 2, IF(platelets < 150, 1, IF(platelets >= 150, 0, NULL)))))

fields.label: Liver
fields.formula: IF(bilirubin >= 12, 4, IF(bilirubin >= 6, 3, IF(bilirubin >= 2, 2, IF(bilirubin >= 1.2, 1, IF(bilirubin >= 0, 0, NULL)))))

fields.label: CNS
fields.formula: IF(gcs < 6, 4, IF(gcs < 10, 3, IF(gcs < 13, 2, IF(gcs < 15, 1, IF(gcs = 15, 0, NULL)))))

fields.label: Renal
fields.formula: MAX(IF(creatinine >= 5, 4, IF(creatinine >= 3.5, 3, IF(creatinine >= 2, 2, IF(creatinine >= 1.2, 1, 0)))), IF(urine_24h < 200, 4, IF(urine_24h < 500, 3, 0)))

fields.label: SOFA total
fields.formula: s_resp + s_coag + s_liver + s_cv + s_cns + s_renal
